fem.text: Tymolin Loneglade holds back invading Orcs and Goblins with Kaylen in a dwarven fortress, and after Kaylen is killed by an orc she slays it and heads for Havenwood.
Oliver Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin, and the Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin, who escape but are separated.
Vaylesh captures Tymolin and lures the Farrelites to the Ebon Hand camp, where Farrel stabs her to death when she refuses him.
